source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: I travel by train to another city.
The train leaves at eight in the morning.

sentences.ar: אני יושב ליד החלון ומסתכל בחוץ.
sentences.en: I sit by the window and look outside.
Outside there are fields and trees.

sentences.ar: אני קורא ספר וגם ישן קצת.
sentences.en: I read a book and also sleep a bit.
